title: Form of forms
html_source:
Aristotle suggested that the Prime Mover, which is the divine or godlike force called the active intellect, acts upon human brains to produce thought in them, and therefore is thought thinking itself.

The soul, which is the form of the body, can take on the form of sensation by processing the sensible forms of external objects. Because objects also have forms, the rational soul can assimilate these forms as well, so that the soul can become all things.
